purpose: Test whether centered cross-donor relational reconstruction adds held-out classification value beyond equal-budget MSE continuation; frozen scGPT and output512D
evidence: CHECKS.json: TRAIN-only seed42 geometry/gradient diagnostics over6 folds; no optimizer or new TEST scores

architecture.operator: largest raw values, retain signed values; unchanged baseline architecture

initialization: same existing fold/seed raw SAE checkpoint; reset Adam state equally in all continuation arms

new_arms.name: continue_mse_relation_strong
new_arms.role: secondary fixed candidate, no TEST winner selection

objective.relation: mean_i KL(softmax_j cos(h_i-mu,h_j-mu)/tau || softmax_j cos(recon_i-mu,recon_j-mu)/tau)); teacher detached
objective.eligible_anchors: other TRAIN donors in same balanced batch; no self or same-donor anchors
objective.probabilities: log_softmax, rows sum1; mean overqueries, sum overanchors; finite/normalization assertions

training_proposal.sampling: four TRAIN donors balanced, within-donor sample without replacement per batch; paired batch indices across all arms
training_proposal.schedule: cosine over1000 steps, same all arms
training_proposal.checkpoint: fixed final1000 step primary; no VALID-MSE-only checkpoint choice for relation models
training_proposal.geometry_only_centering: decoder still reconstructs raw512D h; same TRAIN mean used for teacher and student cosine

pilot.selection: health, finite losses, nonzero gradients, term-gradient ratio, raw/centered reconstruction, memory and runtime only; no new TEST score or label-driven choice
pilot.budget_changes: if necessary establish common budget from TRAIN/VALID unlabeled stability before any new TEST scoring; preserve initial proposed protocol version

evaluation.split: historical fourTRAIN/oneVALID/oneTEST donor rotations; exploratory data reuse
evaluation.optional_secondary: fixed half raw+half reconstruction, declared before TEST; never replace primary based on TEST
evaluation.ridge: TRAIN-only scaling and balanced Ridge; existing common11-alpha grid selected with VALID labels
evaluation.statistics: seed mean within each donor then6-donor equal mean; paired descriptive donor interval; not18 independent donors
evaluation.advance: at least+0.5pp versus original_h and positive matched-MSE difference, >=4/6 positive donors, >=2/3 positive seed means; descriptive gate not significance
evaluation.lock: all selections and protocol fixed before unified new TEST evaluation

interpretation_limits: preserving h relationships does not inject new observed information or guarantee better class separation
cross-donor neighborhoods can still contain technical/biological mixture and are not ground-truth cell-type neighbors
last20-epoch selection does not establish undertraining as the cause of classification failure
continued-training success alone does not establish a relational-loss or SAE-specific benefit
deferred: SDCV supervised feature selection: same residual family as past gates, requires TRAIN-only feature rediscovery; do not reuse full-Kang selected B-cell features
If a reproducible gain is found, add strong non-SAE nonlinear/denoising controls before an SAE-specific claim; independent cohort confirmation needs a separate dataset-specific SAE
code_caveat: author current measure() uses score/(score+norms), whose rows do not generally sum1; proposal follows categorical normalized KL, not a byte-identical code reproduction
